annotations.title: Nearby landmarks and points of interest

description: Nearby landmarks and points of interest — Notable places near a point: landmarks, museums, parks, churches, venues, stations, historic sites and buildings with distance (m and mi), compass direction, short description, category and Wikipedia link. Give place= (a city or landmark name) or lat= and lon=. Optional: radius_m= (10-10000, default 5000), limit= (1-50, default 20), keyword= text filter (e.g. museum), kind= category filter (museum, park, place of worship, education, transport, venue, historic, building, nature, government, area, hotel, health, food, business). Source: Wikipedia GeoData; descriptions CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: geo_nearby
